name: 紅翅綠鳩

illustrationTaxon: Treron sieboldii adult male; adult male maroon wing patch

similarSpecies.distinction: 楔尾綠鳩雄鳥有銅金冠胸及栗色肩羽，尾下覆羽淡肉桂色、尾基寬呈楔形；紅翅綠鳩有更白的腹部與尾下覆羽，雄鳥紫紅翼斑更鮮明。
厚嘴綠鳩有粗厚淡色紅基喙、寬闊藍綠眼圈與栗紅肩斑；紅翅綠鳩喙較灰細、眼圈狹窄並有醒目白腹及雄鳥紫紅翼斑。

rangeMap.note: Partial broad native-range context from northern Thailand and northern Indochina to central/eastern China, Taiwan and Japan. Mainland Chinese subspecies limits are imperfectly known; highlights are geographic context only and do not imply nationwide occupancy. Hong Kong records are separately described as rare winter visitors and passage migrants.

sources.use: Full HKBWS White-bellied Green Pigeon account read: Category I, rare winter visitor and passage migrant in HK; 33 cm. Grey bill with bluish base and narrow blue eye-ring; compared with Wedge-tailed, has whiter belly and undertail ground and lacks chestnut upperparts. Recorded in central/northwest NT and on Po Toi and Tung Ping Chau; records since 1983, mostly 23 Oct–14 Nov and 25 Dec–3 Feb, plus one 23 Apr. HKBWS reports global IUCN LC, decreasing trend. Native distribution includes northern Thailand, northern Indochina, central/eastern China, Taiwan and Japan; mainland subspecies distribution imperfectly known.
Cornell eBird/Merlin account read: both sexes green overall with yellowish-green heads (brighter in males), pale belly and olive-green wings; males have vivid maroon wing patch; global IUCN LC.

Full HKBWS Wedge-tailed Green Pigeon account read for comparator: single HK record, 2016; male has coppery-gold crown/breast and chestnut scapulars, with pale cinnamon undertail coverts and broad wedge-shaped tail.
Full HKBWS Thick-billed Green Pigeon account read for comparator; adult male has thick pale red-based bill, broad blue-green eyering and maroon shoulder patch.
